exposure: Early-pregnancy body mass index (BMI) (<30 kg/m^2 vs. >=30 kg/m^2)
Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) (with GDM vs. without GDM)
cohort: The study included all 401 singleton pregnancies with GDM and 377 matched pregnancies without diabetes in the Kronoberg and southern Kalmar regions of Sweden between 2013 and 2018.
finding: Women with GDM and obesity, especially in combination, had a greater risk for preeclampsia, cesarean section, and delivering LGA infants, along with lower gestational weight gain.
mod_finding: The combination of GDM and obesity increased the risk of cesarean section (OR 1.9), suggesting an impact on mode of birth.
birth_weight: Infants weighed 200g less in obese women with GDM compared to nonobese women with GDM.
